summary: Nexentis Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: NXTS) filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 disclosing Amendment Agreements dated September 29, 2026 with holders of all outstanding warrants from its L.I.A. Pure Capital Ltd. loan facility (originated October 1, 2024, amended May 2026) and its June 15 and June 24, 2026 private placements alongside registered direct offerings. The amendments reclassify warrants from liability to equity accounting and remove certain provisions; no share count, term, or economic consideration changed. No price, premium, or advisor disclosed. The move supports efforts to regain compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1).
